title: 連接詞 vs. 介系詞
courseTitle: TOEIC 金色證書 90 天訓練
source: 使用者提供的 Day 11 教材

sections.title: Day 11 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天接續 Day 10 的關係子句，進入 Part 5 極高頻考點：**連接詞 vs. 介系詞**。核心是 `because / because of`、`although / despite`、`while / during`。這類題目不需要先翻譯，只要判斷空格後面是「完整句」還是「名詞」，通常可以在 **10～15 秒內**解決。

目前尚未有前幾天實際作答成績，因此維持 **860～900 分難度**，並混入前面學過的關係詞、分詞與時態。今天建議約 **90 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜because vs. because of
sections.markdown:
比較：

> Production was delayed **because the machine broke down**.

`the machine broke down`

有：

S = the machine  
V = broke down

所以是完整句。

因此：

> **because + S + V**

---

另一句：

> Production was delayed **because of a mechanical problem**.

`a mechanical problem`

是名詞片語。

所以：

> **because of + N**

直接記：

**because + 句子**

**because of + 名詞**

---

### 仿真例題

> The shipment was delayed _____ severe weather.

(A) because  
(B) because of  
(C) although  
(D) while

空格後：

> severe weather

名詞。

因此：

**because of**

答案 B。

---

sections.title: ③ although vs. despite
sections.markdown:
同樣方法。

> **Although the product is expensive**, it is selling well.

`the product is expensive`

完整句。

所以：

> **although + S + V**

但：

> **Despite the high price**, the product is selling well.

`the high price`

名詞。

所以：

> **despite + N**

記：

**although + 句子**

**despite + 名詞**

---

注意不要寫：

> despite of ❌

正確：

> despite the delay ✅

或：

> in spite of the delay ✅

---

sections.title: ④ while vs. during
sections.markdown:
這組 TOEIC 非常喜歡。

> Please turn off your phone **while the presentation is in progress**.

後面：

S + V

所以：

**while + 句子**

但是：

> Please turn off your phone **during the presentation**.

presentation 是名詞。

所以：

**during + 名詞**

直接建立：

> while + S + V

> during + N

---

## 四組一起記

| 後面完整句 | 後面名詞 |
|---|---|
| because | because of |
| although | despite |
| while | during |

看到這種題，第一步不是翻譯，而是：

> **看空格後面。**

---

sections.title: ⑤ 860+ 混合陷阱
sections.markdown:
### Q1

> _____ the heavy rain, all deliveries arrived on time.

(A) Although  
(B) Despite  
(C) Because  
(D) While

後面：

> the heavy rain

名詞。

而語意是：

「儘管下大雨」

所以：

**Despite**

---

### Q2

> _____ demand increased unexpectedly, the factory increased production.

(A) Because  
(B) Because of  
(C) During  
(D) Despite

後面：

> demand increased

S + V。

又是原因：

**Because**

---

### Q3

> Employees may use the cafeteria _____ their lunch break.

(A) while  
(B) because  
(C) during  
(D) although

後面：

> their lunch break

名詞。

所以：

**during**

---

sections.title: ⑥ Listening｜Part 2
sections.markdown:
今天加入更多「推論型回答」。

### Q1

> Why has production been delayed?

(A) One of the machines broke down.  
(B) About five hundred units.  
(C) At the main factory.

**答案：A**

---

### Q2

> When will the replacement parts arrive?

(A) The supplier hasn't confirmed the shipping date.  
(B) In the warehouse.  
(C) About thirty boxes.

**答案：A**

---

### Q3

> Should we increase production?

(A) How much inventory do we have left?  
(B) The factory opened last year.  
(C) On the assembly line.

**答案：A**

這題已經不是直接問答。

要不要增加產量？

先問：

> 現在庫存還有多少？

非常合理。

---

### Q4

> Didn't the shipment arrive yesterday?

(A) Bad weather delayed the truck.  
(B) At the distribution center.  
(C) Nearly two hundred units.

**答案：A**

---

### Q5

> Who's inspecting the defective products?

(A) Someone from quality control.  
(B) Tomorrow morning.  
(C) About fifteen products.

**答案：A**

---

### Q6

> Why don't we order additional materials?

(A) We already have enough in stock.  
(B) From our regular supplier.  
(C) Approximately $2,000.

**答案：A**

注意這題：

`Why don't we...?`

是建議。

回答的意思：

「庫存已經夠了。」

也就是婉拒這個建議。

---

sections.title: ⑦ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時 **3 分鐘**。

> **To:** Distribution Team  
> **From:** Production Manager  
> **Subject:** Shipping Delay
>
> Due to an unexpected shortage of electronic components, production of Model AX-50 has been temporarily reduced at our Taoyuan facility.
>
> Although our supplier expects to deliver additional components by September 14, some customer orders originally scheduled for shipment this week will be delayed.
>
> The production team plans to operate an additional assembly line as soon as the components arrive. This should allow us to return to normal production capacity within three days.
>
> Customers whose orders are affected by the delay will be contacted directly by the Customer Service Department. They may choose to wait for their original order or select a comparable product that is currently in stock.
>
> Please do not provide customers with estimated delivery dates until the revised production schedule has been confirmed.

### Q1

Why has production been reduced?

(A) Equipment is being inspected  
(B) Some components are unavailable  
(C) Customer demand has decreased  
(D) The factory is being renovated

### Q2

When are additional components expected?

(A) September 11  
(B) September 12  
(C) September 14  
(D) September 17

### Q3

What will happen after the components arrive?

(A) Another assembly line will operate  
(B) Prices will be reduced  
(C) The factory will close temporarily  
(D) Orders will be canceled

### Q4

Who will contact affected customers?

(A) Suppliers  
(B) Production workers  
(C) Customer Service  
(D) Warehouse employees

### Q5

What option will affected customers have?

(A) Receive free shipping  
(B) Select another available product  
(C) Cancel all future orders  
(D) Receive an automatic refund

### Q6

Why should employees avoid giving estimated delivery dates?

(A) Prices may change  
(B) Customers have not paid  
(C) The revised schedule is not confirmed  
(D) The supplier has canceled delivery

**答案：1B / 2C / 3A / 4C / 5B / 6C**

注意今天文章直接出現：

> **Although our supplier expects to deliver...**, some orders ... will be delayed.

Although 後面：

> our supplier expects...

完整 S + V。

---

sections.title: ⑩ 今日錯題解析
sections.markdown:
如果 Q1～Q5 出錯，先不要標記成「單字不熟」。

分類應該是：

**G — Connector / Preposition**

重新做題時只做一件事：

把空格後面的內容框起來。

例如：

> _____ **the high price**

看到名詞。

「儘管」：

→ **despite**

而：

> _____ **the product is expensive**

看到：

S + V。

「儘管」：

→ **although**

同理：

> during **the meeting**

> while **the meeting is taking place**

這應該逐漸做到 **5 秒內判斷**。

---

sections.title: ⑪ 前三天錯題複習
sections.markdown:
快速反射，不要看前面的教材：

> The hotel _____ we stayed...

**where**

因為 `we stayed` 完整。

> The hotel _____ we booked...

**which**

因為 `we booked _____` 缺受詞。

> The employee _____ application was approved...

**whose**

> Customers were _____ with the service.

**satisfied**

> The results were _____.

**encouraging**

> Management considered _____ another office.

**opening**

如果這六個現在可以直接回答，代表第一週到第二週的知識開始真正累積，而不是每天學完就清空。

---

sections.title: ⑫ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先複習 30 個單字，尤其把下面十組直接當成一個單位記：

> supply chain  
> supply shortage  
> meet demand  
> track a shipment  
> distribution center  
> assembly line  
> raw materials  
> quality control  
> production capacity  
> production delay

接著完成今天最重要的口頭反射：

> because → **S + V**

> because of → **N**

> although → **S + V**

> despite → **N**

> while → **S + V**

> during → **N**

最後重新完成 Day 11 小考，第二次限制 **2 分 30 秒**，目標 **10/10**。

如果第一次能達到 **9～10/10 且 3 分鐘內完成**，接下來會繼續往 900 分難度增加混合陷阱；如果錯在 Q1～Q5，則後續會持續穿插「完整句 vs. 名詞」辨識題。

今天最重要的解題反射是：

> **看到 because / because of、although / despite、while / during，不要先翻譯；先看後面是完整句還是名詞。**

**Day 12** 將進入另一組 TOEIC Part 5 高頻失分區：**時間與條件連接詞 `when / before / after / until / once / if / unless`，以及「時間／條件副詞子句不用 will」的陷阱。**

questions.prompt: Production was delayed _____ a shortage of raw materials.
questions.explanation: a shortage of raw materials 是名詞片語，原因使用 because of。

questions.prompt: _____ the supplier delivered the parts late, production was delayed.
questions.explanation: the supplier delivered the parts late 是完整句，原因使用 Because。

questions.prompt: _____ the high cost, management approved the purchase.
questions.explanation: the high cost 是名詞片語，讓步使用 Despite。

questions.prompt: _____ the equipment was expensive, the company decided to purchase it.
questions.explanation: the equipment was expensive 是完整句，讓步使用 Although。

questions.prompt: Employees should wear safety equipment _____ operating machinery.
questions.explanation: operating machinery 是省略主詞的分詞結構，此處使用 while。

questions.prompt: Visitors must wear identification badges _____ their factory tour.
questions.explanation: their factory tour 是名詞片語，時間使用 during。

questions.prompt: The factory increased production _____ demand had risen significantly.
questions.explanation: demand had risen significantly 是完整句，原因使用 because。

questions.prompt: _____ strong customer demand, the product sold out within two days.
questions.explanation: strong customer demand 是名詞片語，原因使用 Because of。

questions.prompt: _____ the shipment arrived late, all orders were delivered by Friday.
questions.explanation: the shipment arrived late 是完整句，讓步使用 Although。

questions.prompt: The warehouse remained open _____ the renovation.
questions.explanation: the renovation 是名詞片語，時間使用 during。

questions.prompt: The company continued hiring _____ the economic uncertainty.
questions.explanation: the economic uncertainty 是名詞片語，讓步使用 despite。

questions.prompt: Please remain seated _____ the safety inspection is being conducted.
questions.explanation: the safety inspection is being conducted 是完整句，時間使用 while。

questions.prompt: The delivery was postponed _____ severe weather.
questions.explanation: severe weather 是名詞片語，原因使用 because of。

questions.prompt: _____ demand increased, the factory extended its operating hours.
questions.explanation: demand increased 是完整句，原因使用 Because。

questions.prompt: _____ the high price, the new product has sold extremely well.
questions.explanation: the high price 是名詞片語，讓步使用 Despite。

questions.prompt: _____ the product is expensive, customer demand remains strong.
questions.explanation: the product is expensive 是完整句，讓步使用 Although。

questions.prompt: Employees may use their phones _____ their lunch break.
questions.explanation: their lunch break 是名詞片語，時間使用 during。

questions.prompt: Why hasn't the shipment arrived?
questions.explanation: Heavy traffic delayed the truck 說明貨件尚未抵達的原因。

questions.prompt: Should we increase production?
questions.explanation: 是否增加產量取決於剩餘庫存，因此先詢問庫存量。

questions.prompt: Who's checking the damaged products?
questions.explanation: Someone from quality control 是 Who 問句的合理回答。

questions.prompt: Why don't we order more components?

options.A: We already have plenty in stock.

questions.explanation: 庫存已足夠，合理地婉拒訂購更多零件的建議。

questions.prompt: A **supply shortage** means:

options.B: there is not enough of something available

questions.explanation: supply shortage 表示可供使用的數量不足。

keyTakeaway: 看到 because / because of、although / despite、while / during，先判斷後面是完整句還是名詞。
